ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity black (central and basal regions) to 35% high-intensity off-white (lateral lobe regions) pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Symmetric high-contrast off-white contiguous regions on the distal lateral lobes (approximately spanning the outer thirds of the fluke) separated by a solid black central band.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 105 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge featuring fine-scale serrations and several larger, non-uniform notches, particularly prominent on the distal edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a concave upward sweep from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered small, high-contrast white circular spots located primarily within the black central pigmentation and along the upper border of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear rake marks (parallel and intersecting) cutting through the off-white pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across both lobes; visible cluster of small barnacles or calcified lesions on the far left tip of the fluke.
